subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'EASILY' is written as '142', 'ESCAPE' is written as '98', how will 'FAMILY' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 ** The sum of positional values of all the alphabets ****× 2 = Code**

71 × 2 = 142 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6ca2155736d53fc4bd37ad4922262784f2a388bc7c2e59e50f9c7dc90f28ba4.png] 

49 × 2 = 98 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95d4cacd2854daf9dbc714e2293410fb68fd7cd9ee91e80c04954afca9f12598.png] 

Similarly,

66 × 2 = 132 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f823699dbc0b21ae8694d8a9eebe59cf65c29ec9c333def54f75a18413ea5443.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
